_notes: MNST ticker metadata. Populated 2026-04-28 as the fourth ticker onboarded after CELH + PG + PEP. Selected for being NCI-free, mature, seasonal CPG that exercises the YoY-basis forecast path cleanly.
_plausibility_note: Ranges in $thousands (MNST renders all USD facts at scale=3, like CELH). Used by unit_detection fallback when no explicit header phrase is found.
_growth_basis_note: model-calc revenue growth driver. MNST defaults to 'yoy' (CPG default) — projects Q[t]=Q[Y-1,q]*(1+g) and preserves seasonality (energy-drink demand peaks in Q2/Q3). Matches PEP/PG default. Per-row override available in Excel via the Basis column on IS DRIVERS.
_stock_splits_note: Do NOT auto-adjust share counts or EPS without verifying the pre/post-split convention of the source filing. MNST historically restates EPS / share counts in subsequent filings to reflect splits.
